llm_response.reason: The website strongly matches several scam characteristics: it uses the official 'Belstaff' brand while offering outlet deals without any proof of official authorization, its About Us and Contact pages are both inaccessible (403 errors and SSL issues) which blocks company identification, the domain WHOIS has no registrant/contact information (hiding ownership), and there is no verifiable business information. These are all clear warning signs commonly associated with fraudulent shopping sites attempting to appear as legitimate outlets for well-known brands. Lack of transparency and poor SSL handling further amplify the risk.
